originalText: {"recordId":"6af855c74b3a78a274deb578","country":"SE","sourceId":"SE-portal","sourceName":"Sweden national procurement","sourceUrl":"https://www.kommersannons.se/Notices/QualificationNotice/61","noticeId":"/Notices/QualificationNotice/61","procedureId":"Försvarets materielverk|21FMV2093","title":"Framework agreement - IF over IP system","description":"The Swedish Armed Forces, SwAF, operates a managed satellite communication infrastructure system on leased transponder capacity for national and international operations. The system is used as a backbone network, supporting SwAF units in Theatre by providing access to the SwAF terrestrial network in Sweden. The satellite Hubs/Gateways in Sweden are currently equipped with fiber optic IFL between the satellite modems and the antenna RF equipment. The current solution is limited to approximately 4-6 km separation. In order to overcome the current separation limits the SwAF is hereby looking to acquire a technical solution for IFL extension over public IP based networks (Internet).
